name: Private Room 2
source:
Boy meets girl at a New York bar. She aims to be a top dancer, but there is a lot of pain on the way. At the drunk momentum they go to her room and start cohabitation...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名男子在纽约的酒吧遇见一名女子。她立志成为顶尖舞者，却要在途中承受许多痛苦。两人借着醉意来到她的房间，开始共同生活…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
